Abstract —This paper summarizes the topics covered in class
on August 19, 2025. The session focused on two main areas: a
review of linear algebra concepts, with emphasis on vectors, and
an introduction to supervised learning. In the first part, vectors
were examined in terms of their definitions, norms, distances,
and operations, highlighting their importance as mathematical
tools for representing and comparing data. In the second part,
supervised learning was introduced through the notions of
features, labels, regression, and classification. The connection
between these two areas illustrates how algebraic concepts serve
as the foundation for machine learning techniques.
